scan_desc: Open the WristKey app on your watch and keep it nearby.
scan_no_devices: No WristKey devices found. Make sure watch app is open and advertising.
paired_empty: No paired devices. Scan to pair.
touch_point_desc: Confirm unlock requests by tapping your personal spot on the watch face instead of pressing a button.
touch_point_howto: Open the WristKey app on your watch → Settings → Touch point.
Tap Train point. A 10-second window opens.
Touch your spot once during that window.
A 10-second recording window runs automatically. Optionally tap again to refine.
The point is saved. On unlock requests, tap inside its ring to approve.
touch_point_hint: Hit tolerance is ~18% of the screen width.
touch_point_fallback: Without training, unlock falls back to regular Unlock/Cancel buttons.
watch_training_desc: Start touch training on your watch from the PC.
watch_training_hint: Training runs on the watch: 10s prep + 10s record.
proximity_desc: Manual RSSI snapshot for the paired Watch.
proximity_hint: Use this while walking away from the PC to collect real RSSI values.
daemon_autolock_desc: Lock when watch leaves, unlock when returns
settings_calibration_desc: Hold watch near PC during calibration.
settings_challenge_hint: How long a challenge/response is considered valid.
settings_rssi_hint: How far the signal must drop before the PC locks.
settings_log_hint: Today's log file is named wristkey.YYYY-MM-DD inside this folder.
cp_desc: Register to show WristKey Unlock tile on the lock screen.
service_desc: Install WristKey as a Windows service to run the daemon in the background.
service_hint: After installing, start the service with: net start WristKey
password_desc: Your Windows password is encrypted with TPM 2.0 (or software fallback).
password_warning: Enter your Windows account password, NOT the PIN!
